SNK Gals' Fighters.name: SNK Gals' Fighters
SNK Gals' Fighters.summary: Sugar and spice and everything nice, that's what little girls are made of... NOT! It's time for the ladies to show who's boss in this superb all-girls fighting fantasy! Eight fabulous femme fatales to choose from and five different game modes! Use Super Attacks and collect and trade special items!
